response.sql: WITH account_links AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id, account_id FROM disp), region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM account_links AS al JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = al.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_count, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM region_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE rs.share > b.average_share

assumptions.assumption: The average is across regions with at least one linked client.

alternatives.interpretation: Include regions with no linked clients as zero-count regions when calculating the average share.
alternatives.sql: WITH account_links AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id, account_id FROM disp), region_counts AS (SELECT regions.region, COUNT(al.client_id) AS client_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A3 AS region FROM district) AS regions JOIN district AS d ON d.A3 = regions.region LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN account_links AS al ON al.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY regions.region), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_count, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM region_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE rs.share > b.average_share
